title: Caching and Chat History Management
summary: This module provides in-memory implementations for caching Large Language Model (LLM) responses and storing chat message history, enabling efficient retrieval and state management for conversational AI applications.

nodes.label: In-Memory Cache
nodes.title: In-Memory LLM Response Cache
nodes.description: Stores LLM responses in memory to reduce redundant calls and improve performance. Supports lookup, update, and clear operations for cached prompt-LLM string pairs.

nodes.label: In-Memory Chat History
nodes.title: In-Memory Chat Message History
nodes.description: Manages and stores a list of chat messages in memory, providing methods to add, retrieve, and clear conversational history for an application.

nodes.label: LLM System
nodes.title: External Large Language Model
nodes.description: An external Large Language Model that generates responses to prompts, which can be cached to optimize performance.

nodes.label: Chat Application
nodes.title: Conversational AI Application
nodes.description: An application that interacts with users, requiring persistent chat history to maintain context across turns.

groups.label: Caching Mechanism
groups.title: LLM Response Caching
groups.description: Components responsible for storing and retrieving Large Language Model responses to optimize performance and reduce API calls.

groups.label: Chat History Storage
groups.title: Conversational History Management
groups.description: Components dedicated to managing the sequence of messages in a conversation, enabling stateful interactions.
